title.narrative: Improvement of capacities in National TB Reference Laboratories in the East, Central and Southern Africa region

description.narrative: Multicountry Africa ECSA-HC - Tuberculosis - East, Central and Southern Africa Health Community - ECSA-HC. This program has the following goals: Improving quality and diagnostic capacity of NRLs as well as build capacity to support TB Lab Networks in their countries. The objectives of this program are: Strengthen the inter-state regional network of National TB reference Laboratories (NRLs) for improved TB management in the ECSA region. To improve uptake of WHO Recommended Rapid Diagnostic (WRD), Quality Management System (QMS), and TB Sample Referral systems (TSRS) to enhance impact of diagnostics in TB control. Consolidate capacity of NRLs to undertake epidemiological/national level- disease monitoring surveys such as DRS, TB disease prevalence and Routine surveillance. To strengthen partnerships for sustainability
